description: S462 Q18 twin — the gate keeps only the narrowing of the cell it tests: a handler inside `if=@user` that reads a DIFFERENT optional cell (`@other.name`) is E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q18): the gate keeps THAT cell's narrowing; other cells stay as Q12 — the handler starts un-narrowed for them.
